title: Seagrove Serenity | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Pet Friendly condo complete with coastal chic decor, a large community pool, and a 4-minute walk to the private beach! Seagrove Serenity by Royal Destinations. Book Harp's Hideaway next door for even more space!
description_expanded: Description: Seagrove Serenity by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 4545 E County Highway 30A, Ste B402 Details: Discover one of the most desirable 30A vacation rentals at Seagrove Serenity, a pet friendly penthouse in the Mediterranean-style, gated community of Seaview Villas. Perfectly located in Seagrove Beach, this condo combines luxury and convenience for your next 30A vacation. This spacious retreat features an open floor plan, gourmet kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless appliances, and a large covered balcony with pool and peek-a-boo Gulf views. The master suite boasts a king bed, soaking tub, and walk-in shower. A second king suite offers a private bath, while a third bedroom with two queen beds provides plenty of space. Added comforts include a washer/dryer and elevator access. Community amenities include a seasonally heated pool, charcoal grills, and gated security. A private nature trail leads to a private community beach access and a scenic forest preserve with hiking paths. From this central location, you can easily explore Seaside, Greenway Station, and The Big Chill and all the dining, shopping, and entertainment that make vacation rentals on 30A so popular. If you’re searching for 30A rentals that are both upscale and welcoming, Seagrove Serenity is the ideal choice. Experience the best of Seagrove Beach vacation rentals with this stunning, pet friendly 30A rental. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home/Community Highlights: - Distance From Private, Gated Community Beach Access: 0.26 Miles (5-Minute Walk or 1-Minute Bike Ride) - Distance From Shopping and Dining at Greenway Station: 0.2 Miles (5-Minute Walk or 1-Minute Bike Ride) - *Pet friendly with approval. - Large Community Pool - 4 Adult Bikes - Spacious Balcony - Wi-Fi - Centrally Located on 30A - Available For Winter Monthly Rentals- Contact our team with any questions regarding pricing for monthly winter rentals. - *Additional Pet Fee Applicable $350 each (pre-tax). Please contact Reservations for approval prior to your stay. Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps 8 3 Bedrooms / 3 Baths One Floor: Bedroom 1 - King Primary Suite, Private Bath Bedroom 2 - King Suite, Private Bath Bedroom 3 - Two Queen Beds, Shared Bath Kitchen, Great Room, Dining Room, Balcony, Laundry Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *For 6 bedrooms/6 full baths, also book Harp's Hideaway next door. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
